description: Build something monumental for Healthcare! At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you! About the Role You care about making complex systems actually work, not just in theory, but in practice - across teams, stakeholders, and real-world constraints. In previous roles, you were likely the person who brought clarity to messy situations: aligning engineers, partners, and product teams to get things shipped. At Tandem, you'll drive how our platform connects with the external systems used across French and European healthcare - owning and driving some of the most critical technical initiatives we have. You'll be based in our France office, working alongside the local team, in close collaboration with our central Integrations team in Stockholm. A big part of the role is deeply understanding both sides: the capabilities and constraints of external systems, and those of our own platform. From that understanding, you'll find ways to integrate them and shape concrete proposals for how integrations should work, together with external partners. You move fast, but not carelessly. You know how to break down complex problems, prioritize what matters, and keep momentum across multiple workstreams. You're comfortable going deep technically when needed, understanding APIs, data flows, and system constraints, while still keeping the bigger product picture in mind. This is a high-impact role where you'll not only deliver projects, but shape how we build and scale technical products at Tandem. What You'll Do Lead integration work with external partners and healthcare systems, ensuring high-quality, scalable implementations. Map external systems against our own platform and propose concrete integration designs to external partners. Act as the central point of coordination between engineering, partnerships, and external stakeholders, bridging the local team in France and the integrations team in Stockholm. Translate complex technical requirements into clear priorities, plans, and deliverables. Work closely with engineers to understand APIs, data models, and system architecture, and ensure solutions are robust and aligned with our platform. Identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and keep projects moving at high velocity. Build and improve how we work - establishing processes, templates, and frameworks for integrations and technical delivery. Ensure strong visibility across stakeholders - tracking progress, surfacing risks, and communicating clearly. Support our sales organisation in answering technical questions from our customers. What You Bring Experience as a Technical Project Manager or similar role in a SaaS, platform, or healthtech environment. Strong ability to drive complex, cross-functional initiatives involving both internal teams and external stakeholders. Technical fluency - comfortable discussing APIs, authentication, integrations, and system design with engineers. Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing clarity or momentum. Ability to anticipate, assess, and manage risk in projects, from scoping through to delivery. Strong communication skills, you can translate technical complexity into clear decisions and direction. A product mindset - you care about building the right thing, not just delivering on time. Native level french speaking. Bonus Points Experience in tech sales, enterprise sales, or enterprise software delivery Experience working with healthcare systems or regulated environments Familiarity with FHIR, HL7, or other healthcar

Vous serez le/la partenaire RH de confiance des responsables Customer Care, en étroite collaboration avec votre binôme, avec pour mission d'aider à façonner l'organisation, pas seulement de la soutenir, et de faire avancer la transformation de manière pragmatique et terrain. Ce fonctionnement en binôme nécessite un fort esprit d'équipe, une réelle capacité de collaboration et l'envie de construire ensemble des solutions adaptées aux enjeux du business. Ce rôle offre une combinaison rare d'influence stratégique et de proximité opérationnelle réelle. Vous travaillerez directement avec les managers et responsables Customer Care sur les sujets qui définissent la performance et la croissance durable : design organisationnel, coaching managérial, talent et succession, cycles de rémunération et situations individuelles complexes. Si vous êtes stimulé(e) par des environnements où les priorités évoluent vite et où les décisions se prennent avec données et discernement, vous trouverez ici la portée et l'autonomie pour avoir un impact visible. En tant que HR Business Partner, vous jouerez un rôle central dans l'une des phases de transformation les plus importantes de Doctolib. title: Senior Optical Design Engineer
description: Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place! E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems. We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life. Overview   We are expanding our optomechanical capabilities, and the success of our projects depends on optical designs that are precise, manufacturable, and verified through rigorous analysis and testing. As a Senior Optical Design Engineer, you will own optical designs from concept through lab validation, turning requirements into lens designs and optical assemblies that perform reliably in the real world. This position is central to our mission of delivering cutting-edge free-space optical systems for space applications, and it will support successful pre-production runs and strong collaboration with our suppliers. This position reports to our Responsible Engineer, Optical Systems, and is based in our Toulouse, France office. Our working language is English.    What you will be doing Design and optimize lenses and optical systems, from first-order layout to detailed optimization with ray tracing and physical optics propagation (POP).   Carry out tolerance analysis and Monte Carlo simulations to predict manufacturing and assembly yield, and define realistic tolerances with suppliers.   Conduct STOP (Structural-Thermal-Optical Performance) analysis with mechanical engineers, verifying performance and margins across operating conditions.   Conduct stray light analysis.   Produce lens and optomechanical drawings, and work with mechanical engineers to ensure designs are manufacturable and assemblable.   Define assembly, alignment, and bonding procedures, and support their implementation in clean room environments.   Plan and execute lab assembly and test, covering alignment, characterization, and performance verification of prototypes and flight-representative hardware.   Characterize components and assemblies through optical metrology, and identify discrepancies . D rive root-cause investigations and design iterations.   Work with suppliers on design for manufacturing, tolerancing, inspection, qualification, and pre-production runs. What you bring to this role A Master’s degree in Optical Engineering, Physics, or a related field, with a strong foundation in geometrical and physical optics.   5+ years of experience in optical design, including lens and optical system design , optimization and STOP analysis.   Proficiency in Zemax OpticStudio, including sequential ray tracing and optimization.   Hands-on lab experience in optical assembly and test, with working knowledge of metrology instruments such as interferometers, wavefront sensors, MTF benches, autocollimators, and centration measurement tools.   Experience with spaceborne optics or qualification to space-relevant standards, such as ECSS. Selection of adhesives, coatings and optics materials.   Strong analytical skills and the ability to troubleshoot problems across simulation and hardware.   A proactive mindset and a commitment to high standards of quality and performance.   Bonus points Experience with free space optical communication systems .   Python and ZOS-API skills for automating analysis or processing data.   Experience with ANOVA methodology, including Gauge R&R studies and statistical post-processing in tools such as JMP.   Practical knowledge

description: Our Mission Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model . Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg. Team Culture At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other. About the Role As an AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri. You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals. No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term. We're still building out our training pipeline and infrastructure. Some pieces exist, some do not, and you will have real influence on what gets built and how. Your work directly shapes how quickly we can experiment and improve our models. Identifying issues and taking initiative is what drives our day-to-day work. Due to the highly collaborative nature of our work you are expected to be on-site at least two days a week. If you are in Berlin, you should expect to travel around every second month for a few days to Heidelberg. We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Major points include improving the maintainability of our code through tests and design & architecture changes. Requirements At its core, you need to be able to dive into a codebase, change the behavior as necessary, and after the change the code should be better tested and easier to understand than before. As such we look for candidates for an understanding of how to design for low coupling and high cohesion paired with the ability to incrementally refactor. Experience with the following technologies is likely to be helpful: Test Driven Development (TDD) Trunk based development Continuous integration Domain Driven Design Nice-to-haves Most of our code is in Python, there is also the occasional Rust codebase. We do not hire for skills in a particular technology or language, but rather ability to learn and mindset, yet experience with these technologies is a plus.
